data.body: Hosted organic sample 31892203411: the exact N=3000/6,000-event/24-commit benchmark took 23.06s on macOS and 15.45s/17.51s/16.64s on Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13. This is another macOS >20s outlier, but still below 30s and not the cause of the 25m45s default phase: the slowest macOS default node was test_hook_falls_back_to_git_when_env_unset at 26.11s, and no node exceeded 30s. The run tested 1809 PS3 (250c623334, parent 588d7df0bd), so it predates the 8f9 build-provenance fixture optimization. Retain the locked workload and keep this ticket open for a fidelity-preserving lever; the evidence does not justify weakening the 24 real Git durability boundaries.
